definition: The standardized formal register of Arabic used in news, government, education, and literature across all Arab countries.
details: The standardized formal register of Arabic used in news, government, education, and literature across all Arab countries. The default register of "Arabic" datasets and models, and precisely the register almost no one speaks in daily life, which is the central data-reality gap in Arabic AI.

explainer.lead: The standardized formal register of Arabic used in news, government, education, and literature across all Arab countries. It is the default register of Arabic datasets and models, yet almost no one speaks it in daily life — the central data-reality gap in Arabic AI.

tiers.eli5: Like training a language model only on formal newscasts, then expecting it to chat naturally at a family dinner.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers building Arabic systems often train on Modern Standard Arabic data because it dominates written sources. A pitfall is that users speak dialects, so models trained on this formal register mismatch real usage.
tiers.paperLevel: Modern Standard Arabic is the standardized formal register shared across Arab countries; its dominance in written datasets creates a gap with spoken dialectal Arabic.

explainer.example: A chatbot trained on news and government text in Modern Standard Arabic struggles when users write in a local dialect.
